English: Godpole Stand
A simple wooden stake raised upon arrival in a new land, marking a space for the gods and gathering the clan for worship.
Offering Table
A flat stone or wooden slab where offerings are left for the gods, fostering unity and reverence among the people.
Wooden Idol Shelter
A modest roofed structure housing sacred wooden idols, allowing larger ceremonies and deepening the clans spiritual focus.
Sacrifice Ring
A hallowed circle of stones for ritual sacrifices and public rites, uniting the clan through solemn tradition.
Sacred Grove
A revered stand of ancient trees, ritually protected and tended, serving as the heart of the clans faith and gatherings.
Priests Hut
A permanent dwelling for the clans chief priest, strengthening the spiritual leadership and guidance of the faith.
Holy Oak Hall
An imposing oak-built hall for communal rites and feasts, fostering deep unity and respect among all clansfolk.
Ritual Pavilion
A grand tented structure dedicated to large-scale ceremonies, attracting distant clans and strengthening faiths bonds.
Diviners Yurt
A richly adorned yurt where seers and diviners interpret omens for the clan, guiding policy and uniting hearts in shared fate.
Great Temple of the Gods
A resplendent temple complex, hewn from wood and stone, standing as the spiritual heart of the North Germanic people and inspiring reverence throughout the realm.
